'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Mykolaiv strikes (2022–present)|Mykolaiv strikes]]
***At least four people are killed and five others are injured in a [[Russia]]n missile strike in [[Mykolaiv]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russian-missile-kills-four-ukraines-mykolaiv-2024-04-11/ (Reuters)]
**[[Russian strikes against Ukrainian infrastructure (2022–present)|Russian strikes against Ukrainian infrastructure]]
***Russia launches [[missile]] and [[drone warfare|drone strikes]] across [[Ukraine]], damaging [[Power station|power facilities]] and causing widespread [[power outage]]s for about 200,000 people. Ukraine says that the [[Trypilska thermal power plant]] in [[Kyiv Oblast]] was destroyed in an overnight attack. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russian-missile-strike-targets-cities-across-ukraine-2024-04-11/ (Reuters)] [https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2024-04-11/ukrainian-power-plant-destroyed-in-russian-missile-attack-ifx (Bloomberg)]
*[[Iran–Israel proxy conflict]]
**[[Israeli bombing of the Iranian embassy in Damascus]]
***[[Russia]] warns its citizens against travelling to the [[Middle East]] amid increasing tensions between [[Iran]] and [[Israel]]. [https://www.cnbc.com/2024/04/11/ukraine-war-live-updates-latest-news-on-russia-and-the-war-in-ukraine.html (CNBC)]
***[[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Joe Biden]] warns that Iran is threatening to launch a significant attack against Israel and promises "ironclad [[U.S.]] support" for Israel in the event of an attack. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-68786054 (BBC News)]
*[[Myanmar civil war (2021-present)|Myanmar civil war]]
**The [[Karen National Union]], local [[People's Defence Force (Myanmar)|PDF]] groups, and other Karenni organizations seize the town of [[Myawaddy]], [[Kayin State]], from the [[Tatmadaw]] after three days of fighting. [[State Administration Council|Junta]] planes subsequently bomb the town, causing more than 1,000 locals to flee into neighbouring [[Thailand]]. [https://www.cnn.com/2024/04/11/asia/myanmar-myawaddy-knu-military-junta-intl-hnk/index.html (CNN)] [https://www.rfa.org/english/news/myanmar/residents-flee-myawaddy-04102024054612.html (Radio Free Asia)]

'''Arts and culture '''
*Archaeologists announce the discovery of new [[frescos]] at the [[Ancient Rome|ancient Roman]] city of [[Pompeii]], depicting [[Greek mythology|mythological ancient Greek]] figures. [https://www.bbc.com/news/science-environment-68777741 (BBC News)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2024 Lake Suviana explosion]]
**A search operation at a [[power plant]] on [[Lake Suviana]], near [[Bologna]], [[Italy]], has recovered the bodies of three workers who were missing after an [[explosion]] two days ago. This brings the confirmed death toll to six. A seventh worker is still missing, while the five injured are still in critical conditions. [https://www.ilrestodelcarlino.it/bologna/cronaca/suviana-notizie-diretta-11-aprile-2024-aponeo2t?live (Il Resto del Carlino)]
*A [[Robinson R22]] helicopter owned by the [[Philippine Air Force]] crashes near a public [[Marketplace|market]] in [[Cavite City]], [[Philippines]], killing both pilots. [https://www.barrons.com/news/two-philippine-navy-pilots-dead-after-helicopter-crash-b2db86ce?refsec=topics_afp-news (AFP via ''Barron's'')]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Capital punishment in Vietnam]]
**A court in [[Vietnam]] sentences tycoon [[Trương Mỹ Lan]] to death for [[Embezzlement|embezzling]] $12.46 billion from the [[Sai Gon Joint Stock Commercial Bank]]. [https://www.dw.com/en/vietnam-tycoon-sentenced-to-death-in-12-billion-fraud-case/a-68793492 (DW)]
*Thirty-eight prisoners escape from a prison in [[Moroni, Comoros|Moroni]], [[Comoros]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/dozens-escape-jail-comoros-capital-2024-04-11/ (Reuters)]

**[[Prime Minister of South Korea|South Korean prime minister]] [[Han Duck-soo]] and all senior advisers to [[President of South Korea|President]] [[Yoon Suk Yeol]] resign en masse in response to the results of yesterday's parliamentary elections.
